purpose: Reviewer-requested primary-layer comparison of vector-mean magnitude, scalar-mean speed, and directional-alignment ratio.

definitions.transport_wind_ms: magnitude of the height-weighted mean earth-relative horizontal wind vector from 50 to 500 m AGL
definitions.layer_mean_speed_ms: height-weighted mean of horizontal wind speed from 50 to 500 m AGL
definitions.alignment_ratio: transport_wind_ms / layer_mean_speed_ms; 1 indicates no loss from directional cancellation
definitions.summary: For each valid hour, compute GFS minus NAM at each matched station, take the station median, then average the five hourly medians.

limits: Alternative layers and interpolation increments require archived WRF output on CHPC.
